name: audio-understanding
description: Produce a canonical local STT plus Nemotron diarization transcript package, persist reusable artifacts, run explicitly selected consumers, and deliver to the exact Flight Deck route.

steps.name: validate-request
steps.description: Reject embedded audio and validate the reference, exact return route, and bounded options.

steps.name: capability-preflight
steps.description: Fail early with the missing binary or model configuration needed for local processing.

steps.name: normalise-media
steps.description: Resolve authorised storage or local input and create mono 16 kHz PCM with ffmpeg.

steps.name: transcribe
steps.description: Run the configured local STT adapter and require timestamped words.

steps.name: nemotron-diarization
steps.description: Run the configured local Nemotron 3 adapter for anonymous speaker timing only.

steps.name: merge-speakers
steps.description: Assign words by maximum overlap, document gaps and overlaps, and form deterministic turns.

steps.name: correct-glossary
steps.description: Apply conservative single-token glossary corrections and retain the unchanged raw transcript plus a complete audit.

steps.name: proofread
steps.description: When requested, produce a constrained proofreader suggestion separately; it never mutates the canonical transcript.
steps.prompt: Proofread conservatively. Do not alter uncertain meaning. Return JSON with suggestedTranscript, suggestions (oldText,newText,reason,confidence), warnings.

steps.name: optional-agent-summary
steps.description: When requested, create a separate summary consumer output without changing the transcript package.
steps.prompt: Summarise the supplied transcript faithfully. Return JSON with summary, decisions, actions, warnings.

steps.name: extract-graph
steps.description: When requested, extract a separate candidate entity/relationship payload for later graph validation.
steps.prompt: Extract candidate entities and relationships without asserting unspoken facts. Return JSON with entities, relationships, warnings.

steps.name: package-transcript
steps.description: Build the canonical transcript independently from optional consumer outputs.

steps.name: run-consumers
steps.description: Record clean skips or collect optional proofreader, summary, graph, and selected downstream pipeline outcomes.

steps.name: persist-artifacts
steps.description: Write the canonical package plus downstream outcomes as hashed JSON/readable text, publish through a broker when configured, and enforce bounded local retention.

steps.name: prepare-delivery
steps.description: Prepare a concise result and stable idempotency key for the exact supplied Flight Deck route.

steps.name: deliver-result
steps.description: Deliver idempotently through the managed kind-33358 plus exact-body NIP-98 Flight Deck writer; failures remain pipeline failures.
